weapon.d: Grants Atk+3. Grants bonus to unit’s Atk = total bonuses on unit during combat.

If a movement Assist skill (like Reposition, Shove, Pivot, etc.) is used by unit or targets unit, grants Atk/Def+6 to unit and target ally or unit and targeting ally for 1 turn.

c.d: At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+2 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+4 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)
At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Spd+6 to unit and adjacent allies for 1 turn. (Bonus granted to unit even if no allies are adjacent.)

builds.name: Killer Lady
builds.desc:
+Atk IV isn’t really needed, but that or neutral would work best. This is really just a build to buff her atk up and make her as hard hitting as possible.
Dragon Fang is because her attack is incredibly good. That damage will do a lot, especially on green ford considering her advantage over them.
Death Blow 3 gives her +6 atk, even with her being neutral, she’ll end up with 61 as her stat, easy.
Vantage 3. With an attack like that, you don’t want that to die. As long as she can keep her attack high there’s no way she won’t at the very least get in a decent amount of damage.
Savage Blow 3 as that -7 HP just makes it easier for her to get the job done. Swift Sparrow works too, since that gets her attack even higher as well.
Brazen Atk/Res 2? Up does that attack. This build is made for her to swipe through enemies in a breeze.
In short? Kind of tanky, but workable pretty well for most situations, it seems.
